title: Build progress (mutable overlay over the gate-locked matrix and slice plan)

slices.description: Slice id -> status. Overrides `status:` in plan/slices.yaml (gate-2).

features.description: Feature id -> status. Overrides `status:` in matrix/features.yaml (gate-1). `descoped` is a user ruling that this rebuild will not build the feature: it leaves the coverage denominator, and validate.py requires its reason under `feature_notes:`. It is progress-only on purpose — the matrix records the reference, which still has the feature.

feature_notes.description: Feature id -> one-line remark carried into the parity report. Required for every `descoped` feature: the reason, and who ruled it.

runbook_amended.description: Slice ids whose boundary wrote something into plan/BUILD_RUNBOOK.md — the S1 entry for the initial write, one per `## Amendment after S<n>` thereafter. Exists so slice_review.py can tell a boundary that had nothing to add from one that skipped the question: without it, both look like silence, and only one of them is fine.

notes.description: Free-form per-slice remarks carried into the parity report.
